prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you ate a salad at a barbecue. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman, esteemed members of the Committee, I want to thank you for the opportunity to clear my name today. 

I am aware of the whispers. I have seen the grainy Polaroid circulating in the press. And yes, I will answer the question: Are you now, or have you ever been, a consumer of leafy greens at a sanctioned neighborhood cookout?

Mr. Chairman, I will not plead the Fifth, because I have nothing to hide. I did hold a bowl on the Fourth of July. I did put a fork into it. But the allegation that it was a "salad" in the subversive, dietary sense is a gross mischaracterization of the facts, fueled by hearsay and paranoia.

Let the record reflect what was actually on that paper plate. 

It was iceberg lettuce, yes. But it was entirely submerged in a pool of full-fat Hidden Valley Ranch. It was buried under a seditious amount of shredded mild cheddar cheese, aggressively salted croutons, and bacon bits. Mr. Chairman, I assure you, there was absolutely zero nutritional value in that bowl. It was a vegetable in name only—a mere crunchy vehicle for dairy and cured pork, as the Founding Fathers intended.

I am a loyal American. I had already consumed two hot dogs—with mustard and onions, no ketchup, as per federal statute—and a generous helping of brisket. My blood pressure was suitably elevated. My cholesterol was doing its patriotic duty. I reached for that bowl simply because I had run out of macaroni salad to serve as a buffer between my baked beans and my pulled pork. 

If this committee is truly interested in rooting out un-American cookout activities, I suggest you turn your attention elsewhere. Why am I sitting in this chair while my brother-in-law, Gary, roams free? Gary brought store-bought potato salad and *didn't even remove the deli sticker from the lid*. 

And what of Aunt Susan? Are we just going to ignore the fact that she put raisins in the coleslaw? *Raisins*, Mr. Chairman! That is textbook subversion! 

I will not be the scapegoat for a witch hunt, nor will I apologize for partaking in a bacon-ranch delivery system. I pledge my unwavering allegiance to the smoker, the grill, and the holy trinity of carbohydrates. 

I yield the balance of my time, and I respectfully request a plate to-go.
